erin.docs: Heads-up, I opened a micro-PR to replace several duplicated function-calling snippets with one tiny, copy-paste friendly example for the quickstart and SDK pages. Goals: single minimal example, show JSON-schema with nullability, short fallback parsing hint, and fix two broken links found in the migration guide. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/3891

samira.eng: Sweet. Drop the snippet here so I can check schema shape and make sure it matches the runtime expectations. Keep it short for quickstart.

erin.docs: Sure, here's the proposed compact snippet (quickstart variant, assumes non-streaming response):

erin.docs: ```json
{
  "tool": "tracking.get_eta",
  "input": {"tracking_id": "TRK-9001"},
  "expected_schema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "eta": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
      "delay_minutes": {"type": ["integer", "null"]}
    },
    "required": ["eta"]
  }
}
```

jon.sdk: Looks good. Confirming client method across SDKs is tracking.get_eta. Two tiny asks: 1) allow delay_minutes null (makes sense), 2) add a one-line fallback hint showing a quick regex or KV parse e.g. `// fallback: /ETA:\s*(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/ or parse "eta:2024-05-01,delay:15"` so readers have a copyable snippet.

samira.eng: Also add a parenthetical note in the snippet text `(assumes non-streaming response)` so folks on Dedicated know that streaming requires incremental assembly + parse. We'll add a runbook entry with streaming variants.

erin.docs: Updated PR: method confirmed, schema allows nulls, added the fallback hint and the streaming parenthetical. I also fixed two links: `/howto/tool-calling` -> `/docs/tool-calling` and removed a dead anchor in `/docs/structured-output#best-practices`.

bors-bot: link-checker: 2 broken links fixed, 0 remaining. docs-lint: passed. snippets-smoke: passed.

kate.pm: Can someone approve? We want this in the next docs push. Small editorial nit: add a one-liner pointing to the longer structured-output page for streaming / guardrails.

jon.sdk: Approving. tiny nit: add `// full: /docs/structured-output#streaming` as a pointer so readers can jump.

erin.docs: Added the pointer and a one-sentence pointer to the full example. Pushed and will merge after changelog update.

samira.eng: I'll add a note in the Dedicated runbook about streaming parse caveats and link to the full example.

erin.docs: Merged and cherrypicked to stable. Closing thread. :rocket:
